title: All Backup & Restore
summary: Backup and restore your phone | Restore contacts, SMS, MMS, call logs, calendar
description:
Protect what matters with backup and restore for your daily essentials: contacts backup, SMS backup (messages + MMS), call logs, and calendar. Choose local backup, SD card backup, or cloud backup and restore so you can recover fast when it counts. No root needed — start your easy backup today and stay ready!

✅ Simple backup and restore

Phone problems often show up after a factory reset, when switching to a new phone, or transferring data to a new device. With this free phone backup and restore app, you can backup and restore the essentials without a long process — no computer required. Make an easy backup, review what you saved, and restore it later in a few quick steps. Perfect before a factory reset, a phone upgrade, or anytime you want a safe copy of your essentials.

📦 What you can back up and restore
✔️ Contacts backup - save and restore your address book anytime.
✔️ SMS backup - back up text messages (including MMS) and restore when needed.
✔️ Call logs - keep call history and restore call log history after a reset or phone switch.
✔️ Calendar - back up calendar events and restore later (works as a simple calendar export / export calendar via backup).
✔️ App backup and restore - keep installers; use it like an APK extractor to save APK, keep an APK saver folder, and export apk backups when needed (only for backups created in this app).

💾 Choose where your backups live

Pick the storage that fits your routine:
✔️ local backup to device storage for quick access
✔️ SD card backup for an offline copy
✔️ backup to SD card before a factory reset or phone change
✔️ cloud backup and restore — upload your backup files to Google Drive or other cloud storage for an extra layer of protection

You can change the backup folder location from Settings to keep your local backup and SD card backup organized.

⏱️ Easy backup - Manual, selective, or auto backup

You can back up everything in one tap, or pick only the items you care about such as contacts, messages, call logs, and calendar. Turn on automatic backup scheduling to keep your data backup current without thinking about it. If a cleaner or task manager closes apps in the background, add this app to the allow list for reliable scheduled backups.

🔍 Preview and manage backups

Preview backup files before restoring and delete older items to save space. This keeps your backup and restore workflow clean and under control.

📌 Before you restore

✔️ Restore works only for backups created with this app; it can't recover previously deleted data.
✔️ This is data backup and restore, not live data transfer between phones.
✔️ Photos and videos aren't included — this tool focuses on contacts backup, SMS backup, call logs, calendar, and app backup and restore.

🔐 Permissions (why they're needed)

The app may request access to SMS/MMS, contacts, calendar, call logs, and storage so backup and restore can run properly. That access is used only to generate local backup files, SD card backup files, and cloud uploads when you enable them. No root access required.

⬇️ Download now and keep your phone data protected with free backup and restore you can trust. Set up your easy backup, choose local backup, SD card backup, or cloud backup and restore, and restore contacts, messages, call logs, and calendar whenever you need them.

Switch phones with confidence — download now and stay prepared!
